comparison.objective: Route a condensate hose with continuous downhill fall into a drain.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual flexible-object routing over supports and nozzle placement; no tools, adjustment setting, or locking.
comparison.success_condition: Nozzle in tundish, hose supported on both steps, released, and cumulative rise no more than 5 mm for full credit.
comparison.reason: Tests global shape control of a flexible hose, not rigid mechanism tuning.
